Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: a new design replaces the client-facing shape of this Task. Rebuild on it. In his words: "Be ambitious. Help us land in the new world where we're set up for the most success in terms of adoption by Jace and evolution into the Etude Cloud world. Don't worry about requiring a lot of churn on existing code of Manabot or sticking with the design as currently written or proposed. None of that matters."

The design is `scratch/design-train-api.md` in this worktree. Read it whole before planning. Beside it: `scratch/ontology.md` (the naming review and his answers), `scratch/sketch.html` (the Training docs page and worked loops; its Parts 2 and 3 still show an earlier state form, the design wins), `scratch/etude-readme-draft.md`, and `scratch/positioning.md` (every remark of his, word for word). They were copied here from the Manabot worktree manabot.aa55a0-move-run-execution.

For this Task: the launcher machinery already built here (out carriage, planned-stop retries, attempt cutoffs, continuation, digest-checked inputs) is kept. What changes is everything a training author touches: run.resume, run.steps, run.save, run.checkpoint with named objects and folder checkpoints, run.checkpoints, run.input, run.seed; seeds as a launch option; `etude run` and `--resume`; a taken run name refused, never resumed; the on-disk layout; `start=` between runs; the Training docs page; and the full renaming in the design's Names section. On how much renaming belongs here he answered "6b": all of it, before release.

He was told the consequences and said "im fine with all of those": this Task gets substantially bigger; one class each for the stored run and the run attempt means the launcher database and the tracked folder write the same record types, with this Task deciding where each field is written; the launcher schema changes again, which EXP-12 (migration, queued behind this Task) must cover; stored data stays readable, nothing in a bucket is rewritten, and renamed Python names keep a warning alias.

The design's "Acceptance for EXP-56" says what done means. Its "Open" section lists what he has not settled: take the first option and do not record those as decided. Earlier steers still hold: the finished-run-marked-failed bug, and EXP-37's points.
